messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 12(3)

Article 12 Procedures for assessing the conformity of machinery. 3. Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) the procedure for assessment of conformity with internal checks on the manufacture of machinery, provided for in Annex VIII; (b) the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX, plus the internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII, point 3; (c) the full quality assurance procedure provided for in Annex X.

manufacturer or authorised representative | shall apply one of the listed conformity assessment procedures | machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) | standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements | "the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply one of the following procedures"

manufacturer or authorised representative | may apply EC type-examination in Annex IX plus internal checks in Annex VIII point 3 | machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) | standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements | "(b) the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX, plus the internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII, point 3"
manufacturer or authorised representative | may apply full quality assurance procedure in Annex X | machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) | standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements | "(c) the full quality assurance procedure provided for in Annex X"
